{{Attr|Corpse}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Null Beast''' was a fast and tanky enemy that appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. While quite fast, it did not spawn with any immunities by default, meaning its only resistance to stalling comes from its size. ==Logbook Description== "''Null Beasts are the most common creatures prowling the [[Nil Zone]], often moving in packs. These creatures travel the endless terrain, and if you're nearby, even in the silence, you're never truly alone.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Beast''' is a bipedal monster with visible fingers, toes, a tail and a head somewhat shaped like a shark. It has purple skins with multiple spikes coming out of its body. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *As it has quite high health, towers with decent DPS like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against this. *As the '''Null Beast''' is the fastest enemy in the event, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be helpful at slowing it down. **As it is a large enemy certain forms of stalling like freeze, the [[Warden]] or knockback will be weaker against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullBeastWalkAnimation.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) NullBeastDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullBeast.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NULLNVOIDNIGHT1THUMB.png|'''Null Beast''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Null&VoidNight1Hour12.png|'''Null Beast''' on the game icon.
